title.narrative: Sustaining the Resilience of Ukraine towards the Emerging Risks and Consequences of the War

description.narrative: Contract related to: Sustaining the Resilience of Ukraine towards the Emerging Risks and Consequences of the War - This 18-months measure will provide support to governmental and civil society initiatives aimed at sustaining social cohesion and resilience in Ukraine and ensure accountability for international crimes committed during the Russian war of aggression. A first component will support the use of data and evidentiary information collected in the context of the early-warning of communities of imminent attacks for the purpose of ensuring accountability for criminal investigations. This will be done in cooperation with the National Police of Ukraine (NPU), the OPG , as well as the International Criminal Court and the International Centre for the Prosecution of the Crime of Aggression (ICPA). A second component will aim to strengthen national resilience and social cohesion by increasing the effectiveness of government and civil society initiatives seeking to remedy the consequences of Russia¿s war of aggression. This will include the facilitation of effective and meaningful stakeholder involvement in government, local authorities, and civil society, by increasing their outreach and networking capabilities, as well as by providing them with concrete expert support for participation in relevant working groups and platforms. A third component will support justice initiatives for instance by supporting the increased application of conflict-sensitive and victim-centred approaches to investigations as well as the development of concepts for an appropriate model for reparations.
